title: 96 ##### 5.9.5 Community The data classified by community was available in respect of 1,66,674 juveniles out of which 33.8 percent belonged to Scheduled Castes and Tribes, the respective percentage in each group being 22.3 and 11.5. There was no correlation between caste and juvenile delinquency. In Bombay City a disproportionately large number of juvenile delinquents arrested belonged to Scheduled Castes as compared with the population complexion in the city.
